```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


Required packages for this figure: 
```{r}
library(RevGadgets)
library(coda)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(rwty)
library(tidyverse)
require(ape)
library(ggpattern)
require(phytools)

```

Now we read in our files: 

```{r}

file_comb_relaxed <- "manuscript_data/log_posterior/sampledancestors/combined_MultiRate.log"

trace_qual_comb_relaxed <- readTrace(path = file_comb_relaxed, burnin=0.25)

summarizeTrace(trace_qual_comb_relaxed, vars = c("origin_time", "Posterior"))


file_comb_strict <- "manuscript_data/log_posterior/sampledancestors/comb_OneRate.log"

trace_qual_comb_strict <- readTrace(path = file_comb_strict, burnin=0.25)

summarizeTrace(trace_qual_comb_strict, vars = c("origin_time", "Posterior"))


file_disc = "manuscript_data/log_posterior/sampledancestors/discrete.log"

trace_qual_disc <- readTrace(path = file_disc, burnin=0.25)

summarizeTrace(trace_qual_disc, vars = c("origin_time", "Posterior"))


#time for the strict clock model rippers
file_cont_strict <- "manuscript_data/log_posterior/sampledancestors/continuous_OneRate.log"

trace_qual_cont_strict <- readTrace(path = file_cont_strict, burnin=0.25)

summarizeTrace(trace_qual_cont_strict, vars = c("origin_time", "Posterior"))

file_cont_relaxed = "manuscript_data/log_posterior/sampledancestors/continuous_MultiRate.log"

trace_qual_cont_relaxed <- readTrace(path = file_cont_relaxed, burnin=0.25)

summarizeTrace(trace_qual_cont_relaxed, vars = c("origin_time", "Posterior"))

```
Read the traces as RevGadgets trace objects for plotting
```{r}
#combined
combined_onerate <- trace_qual_comb_strict_MCMC <- as.mcmc(trace_qual_comb_strict)[[1]] %>% 
  select(origin_time) %>% 
  mutate(Treatment = "Combined - One Rate")

combined_multirate <- trace_qual_comb_relaxed_MCMC <- as.mcmc(trace_qual_comb_relaxed)[[1]] %>% 
  select(origin_time) %>% 
  mutate(Treatment = "Combined - Multi-Rate")

#discrete
discrete <- trace_qual_disc_MCMC <- as.mcmc(trace_qual_disc)[[1]] %>% 
    select(origin_time) %>% 
  mutate(Treatment = "Discrete")

#cont-only
continuous <- trace_qual_cont_relaxed_MCMC <- as.mcmc(trace_qual_cont_relaxed)[[1]] %>% 
    select(origin_time) %>% 
  mutate(Treatment = "Continuous - One Rate")
continuous_multi_rate <- trace_qual_cont_strict_MCMC <- as.mcmc(trace_qual_cont_strict)[[1]] %>% 
    select(origin_time) %>% 
  mutate(Treatment = "Continuous - Multi-Rate")

mega_df <- rbind(continuous, continuous_multi_rate, discrete, combined_multirate, combined_onerate)

```

And combine into dataframes for easy plotting


```{r}

group.colors <- c( "Discrete" = "#004D40", "Combined - One Rate" = "#751F96", "Combined - Multi-Rate" = "#751F96","Continuous - Multi-Rate" =  "#FFC107", "Continuous - One Rate" = "#FFC107")
group.patterns <- c( Discrete = "stripe", `Combined - One Rate` = "stripe", `Combined - Multirate` = "none",`Continuous - Multirate` =  "none", `Continuous - One Rate` = "stripe")


ggplot(data = mega_df, aes(x = origin_time, fill = Treatment, pattern = Treatment)) + geom_density() + scale_pattern_manual(values = group.patterns) + scale_fill_manual( values=group.colors ) 

```

Use The Below to replicate the origin time figure.

```{r}

par(mfrow=c(1,1), mar=c(4,4,1,1))
plot(NULL, xlim=c(265, 285), ylim=c(0,0.5), xlab="Origin Time (Ma)", yaxs="i", xaxs="i", main="", ylab="Density")
lines(density(mega_df$origin_time[mega_df$Treatment=="Combined - One Rate"]), col = adjustcolor("#751F96", alpha.f=0.4), lw=2)
polygon(density(mega_df$origin_time[mega_df$Treatment=="Combined - One Rate"]), col = adjustcolor("#751F96", alpha.f=0.4), density = 11, angle=-45, border=NA, fillOddEven = T, lw=2.5)
lines(density(mega_df$origin_time[mega_df$Treatment=="Combined - Multirate"]), col = adjustcolor("#751F96", alpha.f=0.4))
polygon(density(mega_df$origin_time[mega_df$Treatment=="Combined - Multirate"]), col = adjustcolor("#751F96", alpha.f=0.4), border=NA)
lines(density(mega_df$origin_time[mega_df$Treatment=="Continuous - One Rate"]), col = adjustcolor("#FFC107", alpha.f=0.4), lw=2)
polygon(density(mega_df$origin_time[mega_df$Treatment=="Continuous - One Rate"]), col = adjustcolor("#FFC107", alpha.f=0.4), density = 16, angle=45, border=NA, fillOddEven = T, lw=2.5)
lines(density(mega_df$origin_time[mega_df$Treatment=="Continuous - Multirate"]), col = adjustcolor("#FFC107", alpha.f=0.4))
polygon(density(mega_df$origin_time[mega_df$Treatment=="Continuous - Multirate"]), col = adjustcolor("#FFC107", alpha.f=0.4), border=NA)
lines(density(mega_df$origin_time[mega_df$Treatment=="Discrete"]), col = adjustcolor("#004D40", alpha.f=0.4), lw=2)
polygon(density(mega_df$origin_time[mega_df$Treatment=="Discrete"]), col = adjustcolor("#004D40", alpha.f=0.4), density = 11, angle=-45, border=NA, fillOddEven = T, lw=2.5)
legend("topright", inset=c(0.01, 0.01), c("Discrete", "Continuous - One Rate", "Continuous Multirate", "Combined - One Rate", "Combined - Multirate"),
       fill=c("#004D40", "#FFC107", "#FFC107", "#751F96", "#751F96"), density = c(21, 21, NA, 21, NA))

```
